subject.title: fix(codex): keep progress replies from ending active turns

question: Should Codex `message_tool_only` terminal delivery use an explicit `final` tool argument, or remain enforced only through prompt guidance?
rationale: Both open PRs address the same confirmed bug, but adding a model-facing terminal-intent field is a durable runtime contract choice that automation cannot make safely.

options.title: Adopt explicit terminal intent
options.body: Land this structural approach so plausible progress sends cannot prematurely release the active turn.

options.title: Keep prompt-only semantics
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100156 and accept model instruction compliance as the safeguard.

recommendation.title: Adopt explicit terminal intent
recommendation.body: Land this structural approach so plausible progress sends cannot prematurely release the active turn.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the existing source-reply terminal behavior whose contract this PR changes.
